title: Insurance Act
verified_how: fetched Alberta King's Printer Laws Online catalogue entry (ISBN 9780779862467): title 'Insurance Act', Chapter/Regulation 'R.S.A. 2000, c. I-3', Status 'Office Consolidation', Current to 5/14/2026; the Laws Online index header states 'Acts current to 2026-08-31'
notes: Carries the statutory conditions implied in every policy and the claims, proof-of-loss and payment rules for automobile, life, accident and sickness, and general insurance. Worth flagging: a replacement Automobile Insurance Act sits in the same catalogue marked '(Unproclaimed)' (ISBN 9780779862450), so Alberta's new automobile scheme is not yet in force and the Insurance Act remains operative.
